text:
anna_marketing: Heads up 11 KPI anomaly: launch-posts driving impressions but webinar demos are -27% WoW. Can someone sanity-check attribution?

mike_analytics: looking now. 7d: leads=312, MQLs=48, demos=22. Big chunk of LinkedIn Paid show utm_campaign=(not set).

sophie_ops: running SFDC dedupe + ingestion check. Will report back in 20m.

leo_growth: we deployed a shortlink rewrite on Friday for the launch creative. That could have stripped campaign params. I'll test router patterns against recent hits.

mike_analytics: SQL used: SELECT source, utm_campaign, count(*) FROM raw.leads WHERE created_at >= now()-interval '7 days' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 3 DESC; Top: LinkedIn Paid | (not set) = 84 leads.

marcus_cm: short-term dashboard mapping is fine but must document as derived. Long-term fix on shortlinks.

analytics-bot: daily-kpis.csv attached: leads=312, mql=48, demos=22

anna_marketing: Sophie & Mike confirm dupes vs tagging?

sophie_ops: dupes 3.1% after dedupe. Not dupes.

mike_analytics: confirmed tagging loss. Sample webhooks show utm_source present, utm_campaign missing ~70% of LinkedIn. Shortlink rewrite is culprit.

leo_growth: filing creative-ops ticket and adding inbound-router fallback: if utm_source=linkedin && utm_campaign missing => utm_campaign=linkedin_paid_fallback. Rolling tonight 9pm PT.

marcus_cm: after patch let's add a side-by-side raw vs corrected tile on the KPI board for tomorrow's exec sync.

mike_analytics: will add derived column utm_campaign_derived and tile. ETA ~2h.

anna_marketing: action items: update UTM guide for launch posts, note shortlink change in release notes, call out in Friday KPI sync.

sophie_ops: updating playbook now.

leo_growth: scheduling 15m sync 3:15pm PT to confirm router patch + dashboard. Who's in?

marcus_cm: in.
mike_analytics: in.

anna_marketing: in. Thanks all :thumbsup:
